{{nihongo|'''Niwata Shrine'''|庭田神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Harima Province]].

were later built in the time of {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803}}.

According to the '{{ill|Harima no Kuni Fudoki|Q11498726|qid=Q11498726}}', after Iwa Ōkami ({{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Kami}}) completed final negotiations in the land of Iwa, he gathered the deities who had joined in achieving the great work of nation-building, brewed sake, selected a pure court of mountains and rivers, and held a banquet of consolation. This shrine is said to be that pure court where the banquet was held. It also records that when dried rice carried as emergency food was rehydrated, part of it molded and produced alcohol components, leading to the discovery of sake.

=== Historical outline ===
In the '{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}' {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=register of deities}}, completed in year 5 of {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), "Niwata Shrine" is listed in {{ill|Shisō District, Hyōgo|fa|ناحیه شیسو، هیوگو|ja|宍粟郡|zh|宍粟郡|qid=Q7499122}} of {{ill|Harima Province|be|Харыма (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Harima|ceb|Harima (baranggay sa Hapon)|cs|Provincie Harima|de|Provinz Harima|es|Provincia de Harima|fa|ولایت هاریما|fr|Province de Harima|gl|Provincia de Harima|id|Provinsi Harima|it|Harima (provincia)|ja|播磨国|ko|하리마국|lt|Harimos žemė|nl|Harima (provincie)|pt|Província de Harima|ru|Харима (провинция)|simple|Harima Province|sk|Harima (provincia)|sr|Провинција Харима|tr|Harima (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Харіма|zh|播磨國|zh_min_nan|Harima-kok|qid=Q1047523}}, and ranked as a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=small Shikinaisha}}.

The shrine buildings were repaired in year 11 of {{ill|Kanbun (era)|Q1146228|qid=Q1146228}} ({{ill|1671|Q7610|qid=Q7610}}), but burned down in November of year 3 of {{ill|Bunkyū|Q730266|qid=Q730266}} ({{ill|1863|Q7701|qid=Q7701}}), and were rebuilt in year 4 of {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} ({{ill|1871|Q7746|qid=Q7746}}). In February of Meiji 7 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.
